title: Can Claude replace Harvest? 21/21 checks, 21 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Harvest alternative, a weekly timesheet app where a manager's approval locks the week and fixes each entry's rate, from one written spec: all 21 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 21 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:48): https://youtu.be/Z2wrf7ZLiQ4
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/timesheets
Harvest pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/harvest

Harvest lists a Free plan for 1 seat and 2 projects, Teams from $9 and Enterprise from $14 per seat per month billed annually, with timesheet approvals listed on Enterprise (getharvest.com/pricing, October 2026). Ten seats on Enterprise come to $1,680 a year.

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
